meta.name: ebay-sold-listings-search
meta.description: eBay sold-listings scraper across 8 marketplaces (ebay.com/.co.uk/.de/.fr/.it/.es/.ca/.com.au). Takes keyword plus filters (category, price range, item condition, item location, sort order, completed toggle) and returns paginated real-sale records with itemId, url, title, condition, conditionId, endedAt, soldPrice, soldCurrency, listingType (best_offer_accepted / buy_it_now / auction), isBestOfferAccepted, buyingFormat, bidCount, shipping, totalPrice, thumbnails, seller info, sellerType. Use when user mentions ebay sold, ebay sold listings, ebay sold prices, ebay completed listings, ebay comps, ebay resale prices, ebay auction sold results, ebay best offer accepted, scrape ebay sold, ebay market research, ebay pricing intelligence, ebay flipping research, real sold prices ebay, get sold prices from ebay. Also applies to price benchmarking, sold-price analytics, resale valuation, cross-marketplace price arbitrage, appraisal for collectibles, brand demand tracking on ebay.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索eBay已售商品记录，获取真实成交价
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在eBay上查已售价格做定价或转售决策
copy.tagline_en: Search eBay sold listings to get real transaction prices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to check eBay sold prices for pricing or resale decisions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你给的关键词和筛选条件，从 eBay 的 8 个站点抓取已售商品记录，返回每件商品的售价、成交时间、状态、卖家等信息。
howto.when: 当你提到“eBay 已售”、“eBay 成交价”、“eBay 市场调研”等关键词，或要求查询 eBay 上某商品的真实售价时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下 iPhone 15 在 eBay 上的最近成交价。
say.note: Claude 会抓取已售记录并展示价格等信息。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can scrape sold listings from 8 eBay marketplaces based on your keyword and filters, returning each item's final price, sale date, condition, seller info, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'ebay sold', 'ebay completed listings', 'ebay market research', or ask for real sold prices on eBay.

say_en.text: Find recent sold prices for iPhone 15 on eBay.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch sold records and show prices.

say_en.text: Search eBay sold listings for used Rolex Submariner, price $5000 to $10000.
say_en.note: Claude will filter and return matching results.
